steps.note: The history strip holds every shape at once: a very wide capture, an ordinary one, a tiny 1x one, a tiny 2x (Retina) one, a tall narrow one, and a wide recording. No tile may be drawn bigger than the picture really is, and none may run on past two and a half to one. The fixtures are made by fixtures/thumbnail-shapes/make-shapes.swift; each one has a block at its leading edge and buttons at its trailing edge, so which end a crop kept is visible.
Arrow along to a tiny capture: the accent ring has to sit on the picture, not on the empty hit target around it.
